COMMS REPORT — ASTERIA-7 T+09:42

FDIR EVENT: HGA pointing actuator failure. Signal loss on primary antenna. LGA-2 backup acquired Earth.

CURRENT STATUS: Communications maintained at reduced capacity. Downlink 115 kbps (9.6% nominal). Uplink nominal via LGA.

PRIMARY RISK: Onboard data storage will fill in approximately 6.3 hours at current science collection rate.

ACTIONS TAKEN BY FDIR: HGA isolated, LGA-2 activated, data rate reduced, downlink queue reprioritised.

GROUND RECOMMENDATIONS: (1) Immediately reduce commanded science collection rate. (2) Attempt HGA actuator reset during next contact. (3) Prioritise spacecraft health telemetry in all contacts. (4) Evaluate mission plan with 115 kbps constraint.

MISSION IMPACT: Significant data return reduction. All critical housekeeping maintained.
